content: The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for Pramlintide, an amylin mimetic used in diabetes management, is $2,866 for a dosage of 120 micrograms per injection. The National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) for this medication is also reported in the referenced data. These figures represent the 30-day median pricing as outlined in Table 9.3 of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines.
